productFit.name: Warrior Tripods The Commander
productFit.reason: Warrior sells from its US shop with US prices; I found no European dealer or EU retailer listing. Neutral note: mainly sold in the US.

productFit.name: BOG DeathGrip Infinite Carbon Fiber Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: all4shooters measured (not maker): 2925 g, 78 cm packed, clamp about 150 cm high at 20 deg; counterweight hook max. 11,4 kg (25 lb); tube diameters about 35,4/31,8/28,2 mm
productFit.reason: Sold in the EU as "DeathGrip Infinite Tripod Carbon Fiber" by the Czech online retailer STROBL.CZ; all4shooters (European hunting magazine) reviewed it from that range.

localFacts.fact: DJV: since February 2020 holders of a valid Jagdschein may handle night vision front and rear attachments (Vorsatz- und Aufsatzgeraete) under weapons law (section 40 (3) WaffG); whether they may be used for hunting is set by each Bundesland (exceptions mostly for Schwarzwild).
LJV Hessen asks hunters who use night aiming tech outside Hessen to check the hunting rules of that Bundesland.
Destatis (Mikrozensus 2025): men in Germany are on average 1,79 m (179,1 cm) tall; Fatboy (182 cm) and Warrior (180 cm) reach that on the legs, the Radian (171 cm) does not.
all4shooters measured the BOG DeathGrip Infinite CF at 2925 g and 78 cm packed, with the clamp about 150 cm high at full leg extension and 20 deg.
Local terms: Zielstock / Schiessstock (Dreibein), Kugelkopf, Nivellierkopf (leveling base), Arca-Swiss-Schiene, Ansitz, Nachtjagd.

localPainPoints.pain: German night hunters say tripod rests are steadier than two-leg sticks but bulkier and slower to get ready.
localPainPoints.fix: Set the tripod up before calling or before the game comes, legs wide, thickest sections out; the 2-section Fatboy and Warrior need one lock per leg.

quotes.text: Übertreffen Zweibeiner in puncto Stabilität, können jedoch sperriger sein und die Einsatzbereitschaft verzögern.

localPainPoints.pain: A clamp rest should not mark a wooden stock, and the rifle should stay where you let go of it.
localPainPoints.fix: all4shooters found the DeathGrip clamp held the rifle without damaging the wood stock and kept its position when tilted and turned; owners still report residue from the soft jaw liner (English post).

quotes.text: the gun could be fixed in a stable and non-slip position so that the wooden surface of the stock was not damaged

localPainPoints.pain: Practice: a rest only helps if you have used it before the hunt.
localPainPoints.fix: Practice off the tripod before the season (matches the English post's Predator Masters tip).

quotes.text: Üben Sie den Einsatz des Zielstocks vor der Jagd, um im Jagdfall routiniert agieren zu können.

localGain.point: Standing height measured against the German average man (179 cm, Destatis) instead of the US figure.
Legal context for night hunting with attachments in Germany: weapons law allows them for hunters, the Bundesland decides on use (DJV, LJV Hessen).
European measurements of the BOG (2925 g, 78 cm packed) and the EU load figure of the Vortex ball head kit (25 kg).
Which picks are hard to get in Europe (Fatboy, Warrior) and which are sold here (Vortex, BOG).
